scripts.build: npm run build -w @volume/customer && npm run build -w @volume/control-center
scripts.test:e2e: bash -c 'set -e; test -f apps/customer/dist/index.html; test -f apps/control-center/dist/index.html; (cd apps/customer && exec ../../node_modules/.bin/vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000 --strictPort) & volume_customer_pid=$!; (cd apps/control-center && exec ../../node_modules/.bin/vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3001 --strictPort) & volume_control_pid=$!; trap "kill $volume_customer_pid $volume_control_pid 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT; node -e "Promise.all(process.argv.slice(1).map(async url=>{for(let n=0;n<100;n++){try{if((await fetch(url)).ok)return;}catch{}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));}throw Error(url);})).catch(()=>process.exit(1))" http://127.0.0.1:3000 http://127.0.0.1:3001; CI= playwright test --forbid-only "$@"' --
